operator.coordinates: Original physical r>0,z,tau and normalized physical-angle Haar.
operator.pressureGradient: (partial_r p_n,i*n*p_n/r,partial_z p_n), with actual localized pressure.
operator.advection: For each a+b=n, sum v_{a,r} partial_r v_b+v_{a,theta}(i*b+J)v_b/r+v_{a,z}partial_z v_b.
operator.frequencySupport: Supp(v) ∪ Supp(p) ∪ (Supp(v)+Supp(v)). Include zero, both signs and collisions.
operator.work: Re sum_n conjugate(v_n) dot f_n, and force square sum_n |f_n|^2.
operator.fullField: Apply to the total localized velocity and pressure. A residual of the first correction alone omits nonlinear crosses with initialized and later fields.

inputsStillOpen: Actual localized pressure coefficients for first and later corrections.
Actual total velocity jets through two spatial orders and one physical time order.
Radial, axial and time integrations and original spatial boundary terms.
